note: h5peditor adds the in-browser H5P authoring field widget 'h5p_editor' (alternative to the base 'h5p_upload') and AJAX endpoints (H5PEditorAJAXController on /h5peditor/{token}/{content_id}/...), plus permissions 'access h5p editor' and 'install recommended h5p libraries'. No config. The external H5P content-type libraries/Hub are not installed, so medium/hard cases are grounded in LOCAL state: an h5p-type field and its entity_form_display widget (choosing h5p_editor). Namespaced with 'field_h5pe_'.

evals.prompt: Which field widget does the h5peditor module add so editors can author H5P content in the browser instead of only uploading a .h5p package, and what is the base module's upload widget called?
evals.expected_output: h5peditor adds the 'h5p_editor' widget (choose it on the H5P field in Manage form display); the base h5p module's upload widget is 'h5p_upload'.

evals.prompt: Which permission must a role have to use the H5P authoring editor widget provided by h5peditor?
evals.expected_output: The 'access h5p editor' permission. (h5peditor also adds 'install recommended h5p libraries' for installing Hub-recommended content types.)

evals.prompt: What extra capability does h5peditor provide beyond the base H5P module, and which permission limits a user to installing only Hub-recommended content types?
evals.expected_output: It provides in-browser authoring and installing content types from the H5P Hub via AJAX endpoints; the 'install recommended h5p libraries' permission restricts a user to Hub-recommended content types.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an H5P field configured for in-browser authoring. Inspect the live default form display and state the widget type used for that field.
evals.expected_output: The field's widget type in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default is 'h5p_editor' (the authoring widget).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site one H5P field on the Article type is set to use the in-browser H5P editor widget. Inspect the live form display and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field field_h5pe_named uses the h5p_editor widget in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an H5P field named 'field_h5pe_task' on the Article content type. Configure the default form display so that this field uses the in-browser H5P authoring editor instead of the upload widget. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_h5pe_task component's widget type to 'h5p_editor' (was 'h5p_upload') and save.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article type has an H5P field 'field_h5pe_switch' currently using the upload widget (h5p_upload). Switch it to the H5P editor authoring widget on the default form display. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Change the field_h5pe_switch form-display component type from 'h5p_upload' to 'h5p_editor' in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default and save.
